{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues guitar fits my recent listening, but I would choose only one album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Down Where the Spirit Meets the Bone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and familiar rock sounds right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mono; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little reason to explore it this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its rock sound connects with my interest in You Should Be So Lucky, but I would pass today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Acoustic Classics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Acoustic playing sounds appealing, though I am currently leaning toward electric blues.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Basement Tapes Raw: The Bootleg Series Vol. 11; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An archival collection feels like more of a commitment than I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having recently listened to Old Sock, I would choose this for its connection to Clapton and relaxed blues sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: No Pier Pressure; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for a pop-oriented album during this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: In My Soul; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Soulful blues fits my interest in Memphis, but it would wait for another visit.
